description: Self-contained SRS repository used as the conformance fixture for ext:discovery (RFC-012). Contains 8 Tier 2 Records across 3 instantiated types — article, project and metric — drawn from a 4-type package whose fourth, byline, is the inline composite range of article.byline and carries no Records of its own. Between them the Fields span every RFC-032 fieldType classification I-120 rules on, searchable and excluded. Also 1 Tier 0 Note, 2 Containers, and instances with tags and lifecycleState set. Migrated to RFC-038 tree-authoritative storage (Revision 13) — see conformance/discovery/README.md.
title: Discovery Contract Conformance Fixture
